coverage: All records in OPM EHRI employment extracts. All work schedules; count field summed, not FTEs. EHRI excludes USPS, several intelligence bodies, most legislative/judicial staff and other groups listed by OPM.
limitations: Net snapshot changes are not layoffs, vacancies or required hiring. Different seasons and reorganizations affect comparisons. Groups absent in either extract remain missing, never zero. September 2026 has approximately 10,000 missing defense Status records according to OPM. August is retained for a less-affected comparison. No automatic correction or imputation is applied.
